name: bmd-studio
description: B.M.D Studio Management System — operational platform for a Kenyan radio, broadcasting, podcast, photography and livestream studio.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bmd/shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db redis minio
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U bmd -d bmd_studio
